page.overview:
Who is Adam Blackveil?

This abnormal White Event was hastily fired from the Superflow due to the catastrophic, multiversal phenomenon known as the "incursions." The Builders, creators of the universal systems that blessed Nightmask, attempted to stabilize the Multiverse by destroying Earths. With this new Builder threat, Nightmask and Starbrand, as well as fellow Builder systems Ex Nihilo and Abyss, were recruited into the Avengers. Following the Builder War, Nightmask, Starbrand, Ex Nihilo, and Abyss joined Sunspot's Multiversal Avengers to traverse the Multiverse and find out what was causing the Multiverse to collapse. Their inquiry led them to the source of the incursions, the Ivory Kings a.k.a. the Beyonders, but the process caused Nightmask to cease to exist.

Nightmask returned to life when the Multiverse was restored, and he enrolled in a college with Starbrand under the name Adam Blackveil, until Starbrand's untimely death.

After a therapy session with the new Captain Universe, Shang-Chi was told the presence of it was because the universe was dying. Captain Universe and "Blackveil" met, and as she managed to translate his language correctly, she discovered his name was Nightmask and he was announcing that the White Event was coming to Earth. In that moment, a blaze of lightning from outer space hit the Earth.

Nightmask led the Avengers in finding the Starbrand host, Kevin Connor, who was located at the ruins of a college, and aided them in destroying his empowerment.
